# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

completion:
In the “Test Results” column, add any failing results by typing:

   - `N/A` if a test could not be performed. To determine when this is the case, follow [section 4 (N/A)](#N/A-when-not-applicable)](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/safety-testing-electrical-equipment-an-eeagc-guide/safety-testing-electrical-equipment-information-on-the-eeagc-members-safety-testing-protocol) of [section 49 (4) (a) (b)](#section-49-(4)-(a)-(b)) of [The Electricity at Work Regulations 1989](https://www.hse.gov.uk/pubns/books/l72.pdf)
   - `FAIL` if a test failed. A test fails depending on whether
